option_relations.rationale: Klebsiella pneumoniae sepsis is a specific type of gram-negative bacterial sepsis, but there is no direct relation to Vibrio vulnificus infection.
Gram-negative bacteremia secondary to acute pancreatitis describes a cause and type of infection, but it is unrelated to Vibrio vulnificus infection.
Gram-negative bacterial sepsis (Enterobacteriaceae) is a broad category of infection, but it does not specifically relate to Vibrio vulnificus infection.
Raoultella planticola bacteremia is a specific bacterial infection, but it is unrelated to Vibrio vulnificus infection.
